title: Companies Law, 5759-1999
source_id: ס"ח תשנ"ט, 189 (Sefer HaChukim 5759, p 189); Knesset IsraelLawID 2000289; Wikisource page 'חוק החברות'
verified_how: Knesset Open Data KNS_IsraelLaw record fetched 21 October 2026 through an Israeli address (a short-lived EC2 relay in il-central-1, since terminated), because knesset.gov.il answers Singapore addresses with a redirect to a geo-maintenance page: IsraelLawID 2000289, Name 'חוק החברות, התשנ"ט-1999', KnessetNum 14, PublicationDate 1999-05-27, LatestPublicationDate 2024-09-15, LawValidityDesc 'תקף', ValidityFinishDate null, LastUpdatedDate 2021-08-15. KNS_LawBinding returned 40 rows, every one BindingTypeDesc 'מתקן' (none 'החוק המקורי'); the first row's PageNumber is '189', which matches the Wikisource header 'ס״ח תשנ״ט, 189'. The Hebrew Wikisource page carries the Knesset legislation number 2000289 in its {{ח:מאגר}} template.
notes: The deposited text has 11 parts, headed: interpretation; formation of the company; structure; administration; the shareholder; office-holders; capital; acquisition of companies; dissolution (Part 8A); general provisions; and cancellation, transitional provisions, application and commencement. Observed in the deposited text: 378 consecutive integer section numbers (1 to 378) and 179 lettered sections (for example 116א, 123א), 11 parts, the Fourth Schedule (items of a digital address, cross-referenced to section 123א), the signature block, and 74 occurrences of 'בוטל' (repealed text). One section label, 351ו, occurs twice; not investigated. The page header lists, besides the Law at p 189, a ת״ט (correction) entry at ס״ח תשס״ב p 484; the header's citation string was not compared item by item with the 40 binding rows.
text_format: MediaWiki source of the consolidated Hebrew text, with its citation apparatus (the ח:תיבה templates carry the Sefer HaChukim references and Knesset PDF links; ח:סעיף templates open each section)

text_caveat: Unofficial consolidation. Israel publishes no free official consolidated text; the official version is the original publication in Reshumot plus every amending Act. The text is the law as maintained on Hebrew Wikisource at retrieval (page revision 3088229, last edited 2026-10-12T09:30:10Z), not a historical vintage.
